title: Good in principle, but ...
body:
WIO has a huge weakness:
Transfers take much too long. My last transfer, which was verifiably received by WIO on Monday at 14:37, has not yet been credited today, Thursday at 17:28. 
With Revolut, this usually works almost real time. 
If you have the choice and the possibility, you should rather use Revolut.
author: Gerd DO

title: Introduced pointless “enhanced security”
body:
With the recent update, whenever you add a new beneficiary you have to wait 4 hours in order to be able to use it, with no way around it. So if you ever want to split a bill with your friend and want to pay them on the spot, it’s impossible, if you have never transferred before to their account. 🤦🏻‍♂️

This is by the way the only bank I know of where you actually have to create a contact in order to transfer money to them. You cannot just transfer money to an account. This is also completely pointless. Why would I want to save every person I might send once some money as a permanent contact?

title: Terrible UI and UX
body: I don’t know who decided the UI was a good idea. It makes no sense. It’s not intuitive. It’s not like other apps. The entire app needs to be redesigned. And the ads for other features are annoying. I don’t care about the stories at the top. I should be able to dismiss everything in the explore section. Maybe look at Revolut for an example of a good UI. Also it just takes too long for the app to load and animations are not smooth. Terrible engineering. And I turned off marketing notifications and it still sent me one. I just wanted notifications relating to my account, nothing else!
